description: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION RANGES ONLY, 0-264 completed months inclusive, for Male and Female. Previous 0-217 entries retained unchanged. New ages 218-264 interpolated toward example early-adult values. These are not medically validated healthy reference intervals, nor measurements, diagnoses, or safe clinical form defaults.
clinicalSafetyNote: Never auto-fill actual patient records with these ranges. For 0-19 years use age/sex growth percentiles and BMI-for-age; WHO 5-19 years supplies height/BMI but weight-for-age only 5-10 years. Adult weight depends on actual height and BMI (healthy category 18.5 to <25 at age >=20). BP in children under 13 depends on age, sex and height; normal adult BP is below 120/80. Vision must be measured using age-appropriate tests; Hb requires measured blood test and population/sex-specific cutoffs; MUAC cutoffs are not general healthy percentiles.
rangeSemantics: Hyphen-separated bounded example strings for software UI tests. Not a set of WHO percentiles or normal/healthy screening reference intervals; independent weight and height intervals cannot determine healthy BMI.

fieldCaveats.weight: Synthetic illustration only, especially ages 120-264; healthy body weight must be assessed against actual measured height and age-specific BMI method.
fieldCaveats.height: Illustrative age-and-sex population band, not a definitive healthy interval.
fieldCaveats.headCircumference: Illustrative only; routine growth chart reference not established here for school-aged children.
fieldCaveats.muac: Illustrative example without an established universal healthy age- and sex-specific interval, including adults.
fieldCaveats.bloodPressureValue: Illustrative only; not a clinically validated healthy band. Requires actual readings and age-specific interpretation.
fieldCaveats.visionLeft: For ages under 4 years, numerical Snellen-style range not developmentally appropriate.
fieldCaveats.visionRight: For ages under 4 years, numerical Snellen-style range not developmentally appropriate.
fieldCaveats.hb: Illustrative only; WHO anemia screening thresholds are lower cutoffs, NOT upper/lower lab healthy reference ranges.
